description: time_day as the model is told it - what the tool does, and what each of its arguments is.
arguments:
  person: "The person: their id, or their name as the world has it."
  day: "Which day, counted from today: 0 today, 1 tomorrow, -1 yesterday; leave it out for today."

Reads a person's day: what they do when, and where, from their routine, their schedules and their plans, each block with the kind of time it is and where it comes from. It changes nothing.
